# Parkblick

> Berlin-first explorer for official public parks and green spaces. Static,
> source-backed, and free of paid Google services.

Canonical URL: https://parks.soli.blue/
Language: German
Geographic scope: Berlin, Germany

## What the site provides

- A map and searchable list of Berlin public parks and green spaces
- District and positively matched amenity filters
- Optional browser geolocation or a map-selected origin
- Local straight-line distance and 5/10/15-minute estimates
- Visible data source, map attribution, methodology, and freshness

The time bands are estimates, not routed walking isochrones. Missing amenity
coverage is not evidence that an amenity is absent.

## Public static data

- https://parks.soli.blue/data/parks.geojson — normalized park geometry
- https://parks.soli.blue/data/parks-index.json — search and nearby index
- https://parks.soli.blue/data/summary.json — totals and freshness
- https://parks.soli.blue/data/sources.json — source provenance and coverage

These files are build artifacts, not a stability-guaranteed public API. The
canonical park identifier is Berlin's official PITID.

## Sources and terms

Park and amenity data: Land Berlin WFS services, dl-de-zero-2.0.
Background map: basemap.de Web Vektor.
Project code: MIT.
